props.headline: Mobile Service Truck
props.subhead: Need mobile service for your commercial truck? Our Mobile Service technicians are here to help. Your one-stop shop for all of your commercial truck repair needs.

image.alt: A Sun State mobile service truck

props.text:
Give us a call today for your mobile service truck appointment. Available at our Tampa, Sarasota and Davenport locations, Monday–Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM.

Our mobile service team is equipped to perform many repairs and maintenance services at your location, helping you reduce downtime and keep your operation moving without the added inconvenience of transporting your vehicle. Whether you're stuck roadside or at a job site, our technicians provide efficient, on-the-spot repairs for trucks and trailers alike.

stats.label: Mobile service hours, Monday through Friday
Certified factory-trained technicians behind every call

values.heading: A service bay that drives to you.
values.body: Each mobile truck carries diagnostic equipment, tooling and commonly needed parts, backed by our parts department and supplier network. Work that requires a lift, alignment rack or fabrication is scheduled into the shop instead.

items.title: On-site diagnostics
items.body: Fault code reads, sensor and aftertreatment checks and driveability diagnosis performed at your location so you know what the repair takes before the unit moves.

items.title: Preventative maintenance
items.body: Scheduled PM services, fluid and filter changes and inspections performed in your yard, keeping units available instead of shuttling them to the shop.

items.title: Roadside and job-site repair
items.body: Efficient, on-the-spot repairs when a truck or trailer is stuck roadside or at a job site, aimed at getting you back on the road the same visit.

items.title: Brakes, suspension and air systems
items.body: Common chassis work including brake service, air leaks, suspension components and related adjustments handled from the mobile truck.

items.title: Electrical and lighting
items.body: Batteries, charging systems, harnesses, lighting and trailer wiring repairs, including the electrical faults that keep a unit out of DOT compliance.

items.title: Trailer and liftgate repair
items.body: Trailer repairs on site including liftgate service, doors, lighting and running gear, with liftgate installations, remounts and parts handled in the shop.

values.heading: Trailers, wherever they sit.
values.body:
Sun State Trailers offers a mobile service that comes out to where you are to repair your trailer, so you can get back on the road as soon as possible. Whether you're stuck roadside or at a job site, our expert technicians are ready to provide efficient, on-the-spot repairs to minimize downtime.

If the job needs the shop instead, we have convenient locations in Tampa, Davenport and Sarasota with dedicated trailer repair bays.

values.eyebrow: HOW TO GET A TRUCK ROLLING
values.heading: Three ways to reach us.

items.title: Call dispatch
items.body: Tell us where the unit is, what it's doing and whether it's loaded. We'll confirm availability and an arrival window.

items.title: Request form
items.body: Choose the mobile service option on the service appointment form and add your service address, unit details and fault codes.

items.title: Certified Fleet
items.body: Certified Fleet provides after-hours support from 5:00 PM to 8:00 AM, so help is available outside mobile service hours.

items.a: Our mobile service technicians come to your location with a fully equipped service truck to perform many repairs, diagnostics and preventative maintenance services, so you reduce downtime and avoid transporting the unit.

Mobile service is available from our Tampa, Sarasota and Davenport locations Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Outside those hours, Certified Fleet provides after-hours support from 5:00 PM to 8:00 AM.

items.q: How do I request a mobile service truck?
items.a: Call 800-741-7566 for your mobile service truck appointment, or submit the service appointment request form and choose the mobile service option with your service address.

items.q: What can be repaired on site?
items.a: Many repairs can be completed at your location, including diagnostics and fault code analysis, preventative maintenance, brake, suspension and air system work, electrical and lighting repairs, and trailer repairs including liftgate service. Work that requires a lift, alignment rack or fabrication is scheduled into the shop.

items.q: Do you provide mobile trailer service?
items.a: Yes. Sun State Trailers offers mobile service that comes out to where you are to repair your trailer. Whether you're stuck roadside or at a job site, our technicians provide efficient, on-the-spot repairs to minimize downtime.

Mobile service runs out of Tampa, Sarasota and Davenport, covering Central and Southwest Florida including Hillsborough, Polk, Sarasota, Manatee, Pinellas, Pasco and Hernando counties. Call to confirm coverage for your address.

items.q: Do you service fleets at their own yards?
items.a: Yes. Fleets, municipalities, school districts and contractors use mobile service for scheduled PM programs performed on site, keeping units in service and reducing shuttle time between your yard and the dealership.

values.heading: Give us a call and we'll come to you.
values.body: Mobile service technicians run Monday–Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM out of Tampa, Sarasota and Davenport, with after-hours support through Certified Fleet.
